svg.title: Half
svg.desc: The Half logo played as one of the game's own shapes. A block with the wordmark knocked out of it rests above a balance; a line is dragged through it 7 degrees off vertical and released. The block turns until that cut stands upright, breaks along it and falls into the pans, the counter of the a dropping as a chip of its own. The beam settles at 2.4 degrees and the pans report 48.54 against 51.46, a score of 97.1: Half was 11 px to the right. Behind the pieces the whole block returns as an outline, the cut in red and the true half dashed beside it, before everything resets and the block is whole again.
